hint.StarMapAction: Applies across all saves. Preview is reversible. Permanent survey makes this shortcut analyze the current starmap immediately, without another prompt. It opens rocket routes and skips telescope work and Data Bank rewards. Fuel, range and landing rules still apply. Debug and sandbox flags are preserved. To undo a survey, load an earlier save.
hint.Modifier: Use only this modifier together with the starmap key. On Mac, Alt is Option; Fn may be needed for function keys.
hint.CanvasModifier: Use this modifier together with the canvas key. The canvas is the shared map containing all worlds.
hint.FunctionKey: Runs the selected starmap action. Press again to end an active preview.
hint.CanvasFunctionKey: Preview the shared map containing all worlds. Press again to return to your previous view.
hint.Language: Applies to this mod. Save and reopen options to refresh their language. Other languages fall back to English.
hint.Feedback: Off by default. Enable routine action messages here for all saves. Errors still appear when action is needed.
world.preview.hint: View this asteroid's terrain. Exploration and visits stay as they are.
world.end.hint: Return to the previous world and camera view.
status.star.on: Starmap preview on. Press {0} to return.
status.canvas.on: Canvas preview on. Press {0} to return.
status.world.on: Previewing {0}. Use End preview to return.
status.survey.done: Analyzed {0} starmap cells. Navigation uses the saved analysis.
status.survey.empty: The current starmap is fully analyzed.
error.callback: Analysis was applied, but a mod could not refresh its state. Check Player.log before continuing. Load the earlier save to undo.
error.conflict: Both actions use {0}. Choose different shortcuts in Mod Options. The canvas shortcut is paused until then.
